q: Cohesion and adhesion are two types of ____ forces. 2024
e: Cohesion and adhesion are both attractive forces that act between molecules.

q: ____, air, steam, and foam are generally considered to be compressible. 2024
e: Gases and foam are compressible fluids whose density varies with pressure.

q: ____ and adhesion are two types of intermolecular forces. 2026
e: Cohesion and adhesion are the main types of intermolecular attractive forces.

q: Fluid dynamics concerns with the fluid in ____. 2024
e: Fluid dynamics is the branch of physics studying fluids in motion.

q: The volume of a liquid does not depend on pressure if the ____ is constant. 2025
e: Liquids are nearly incompressible, so their volume remains constant at a fixed temperature.

q: The SI unit of viscosity is sometimes referred to as the ____. 2026
e: The SI unit of dynamic viscosity, pascal-second, is also called the poiseuille.

q: ____ helps bringing water up into the roots. 2025
e: Capillary action allows liquids to flow upward against gravity in narrow spaces.

q: The air flow moving above the top curved surface of the wing has a longer distance to travel and needs to go ____ to have the same transit time as the air traveling along the lower flat surface. 2025
e: Air over the curved upper surface of an airfoil travels faster to match transit time.

q: The viscosity of gases ____ with an increase in temperature. 2025
e: Gas viscosity increases with temperature due to higher molecular interaction rates.

q: At a river junction where water streams are swirling, the flow is usually ____ rather than laminar. 2025
e: Swirling and chaotic fluid movement is characteristic of turbulent flow.

q: The SI unit of surface tension is ____. 2025
e: Surface tension is defined as force per unit length.

q: Capillarity does not occur for ____ liquids. 2025
e: Non-wetting liquids depress rather than rise due to weak adhesion relative to cohesion.

q: ____ and adhesion are two types of intermolecular forces. 2025
e: Intermolecular forces are divided into cohesive and adhesive interactions.

q: Cohesion and ____ are two types of intermolecular forces. 2025
e: Adhesion is the attraction between dissimilar molecules.

q: In turbulent flow, the flow or path of the fluid particles are ____. 2025
e: Turbulent flow is defined by chaotic and irregular particle paths.

q: ____ refers to forces between molecules of same substance. 2025
e: Cohesive forces hold molecules of the same substance together.

q: The resistance to fluid motion (or) internal resistance of fluid is called ____. 2025
e: Viscosity measures a fluid's internal friction and resistance to movement.

q: There are ____ ways to measure the fluid's viscosity. 2026
e: Fluid viscosity measurement is categorized into two main methodologies.
